m.h:
Papaya fruits grow on papaya trees, and they're used in Summoning, Hunter and Farming. Once a papaya tree has grown fully, it can be harvested repeatedly, with a papaya growing back every 45 minutes for a maximum of six.

If possible, you should use a giant ent familiar, which has a 50% chance of doubling the yield of papayas, giving you an average of 9 papayas per patch instead of 6. That makes this method work well with other harvesting money makers, like picking cactus spines.

As this uses the same patches as palm trees, it cannot be used at the same time as the picking coconuts method. Whichever one is more profitable should be used.

Raw potatoes are the base ingredient for all types of potatoes with toppings. There is a consistent demand for raw potatoes on the Grand Exchange, and someone has to pick them!

Potatoes can be found in potato fields, and the best free-to-play location is north of the Lumbridge cow pen. Starting off at the Varrock lodestone, walk the road south, going through the fence. The potato field is directly to the south east. Use of Surge can reduce travel time.

Pick the potatoes - travelling diagonally along the rows is most effective. Members can store potatoes in sacks to reduce the amount of time spent banking, and increase profit earned per hour. Potato seeds are sometimes obtained from picking potatoes on members worlds; it is therefore recommended to do this method on a free to play world.

Teleport to the Burthorpe lodestone and bank there. Teleport back to the Varrock lodestone and run back to the potato field to continue picking potatoes.

m.h:
See also primal fruit pulp for info on fruit. Harvesting primal fruit allows a player to get farming XP while collecting valuable fruit. Once a plant has fully grown, fruit can be collected regularly without additional input. Higher level fruit gives more experience, more pulp and often more profit. A player can start as early as Farming with just collecting dragonfruit in cactus patches, Farming for Avocado in bush patches and Farming for Ciku in fruit patches. Fruit that gives more XP and pulp is unlocked at 105, 107, 111, 113, and 116 Farming (boostable, pork pie gives +5). The master farmer gives a 10% chance to get an additional piece of fruit at the bush or fruit tree patches. Unlocking Bountiful Harvest 2 from the Garden of Kharid gives a 7% chance of an additional item upon each harvest.

A primal fruit run consists of 3 parts:

Bushes

For the bush patches a wolpertinger doubles yield and XP. The bush can be clicked once per tick for faster harvesting. The patches are at:

  • Champion's guild, reachable from the Combat bracelet or Varrock lodestone.
  • Rimmington, reachable from a (modified) Teleport to house or Port Sarim lodestone.
  • Ardougne monastery, reachable with Kandarin monastery teleport.
  • Crwys clan, reachable with a teleport crystal, spirit tree or Prifddinas lodestone.
  • Etceteria, reachable with a spirit tree, fairy ring (CIP) or Ring of Wealth.
Fruit trees

For the fruit tree patches a giant ent gives a 50% chance to get an extra piece of fruit. The tree can be clicked once per tick for faster harvesting, but be careful of clearing the patch (chopping it down is not harmful by itself). The patches are at:

  • Tree Gnome Stronghold, reachable with a spirit tree, which can be found at the Crwys clan, grand exchange or player owned farm.
  • Brimhaven, from the spirit tree or Karamja lodestone.
  • Catherby, from the lodestone or lunar spell.
  • Herblore Habitat, from the Witchdoctor mask or a Juju teleport spiritbag (consumed).
  • Lletya, from a teleport crystal or the Tirannwn quiver 1.
  • Meilyr clan, from a teleport crystal, Tirannwn quiver 4 or the Prifddinas lodestone.
  • Outside the Tree Gnome Village, from a gnome glider (Al Kharid or Meilyr clan) or spirit tree.
  • Dalia's Tree Nursery, south of Wendlewick, from the Marigold Farm option on Wendlewick Teleport on the normal spellbook.
Cacti

The cactus patches give increased yield with bountiful harvest, and the giant ent familiar (which gives a 50% chance to harvest one extra item), but not the outfit. The patches are at:

  • Al Kharid, reachable from the glider or lodestone.
  • Het's Oasis, reachable from the Al Kharid lodestone
  • Menaphos, reachable from the lodestone.
  • Anachronia, reachable from the northern totem Anachronia Teleport or the lodestone. This patch is very far from the lodestone.

The order in which these runs are done does not matter, but by switching the fruit trees and bushes a player can re-use of either a giant ent or a wolpertinger pouch if they log out between runs.

By using the fruit on a tool leprechaun they will note all other pieces of that type in an inventory.

inp.nt: 1,000 beans each; 400k for 2k beans (buying ado drags) = 200gp/bean or 200k/potion

out.nt: only with scroll of life

m.h:
Have your farming run gear on for maxing your yields, after saving up some of your Beans purchase Supreme growth potion (leafy). Drink your Juju farming potion, pick the Herb patch, compost it, plant the seed, use the Supreme growth potion (leafy) on the patch, pick the herbs. Rinse and repeat.

The Falador Herb Patch is the best location for this, due to the leprechaun being stationary and extremely close to the patch. You can pay the leprechaun 2500 Coins to compost the patch for you, it saves a lot of time.

Grace of the elves can save a bit of time running to the leprechaun, but reduces profit due to the cost of porter charges.

Patch bomb can save a lot of time harvesting but take a while to acquire

m.h: Pick up eggs at Fred's Farm. Once you enter the farm, close the gate behind you and kill all the chickens outside the gate using cheap ranged/magic weapons (such as a chargebow or air staff). Chickens will then only respawn and spawn eggs inside the gate. Stay at the centre of the farm, and area loot as eggs shows up. It is recommended to keybind area loot to make picking up eggs easier.

m.post:
Pickpocketing success chance decays over time (1% per 7.2 seconds after initial bonus success pickpockets), so stacking more buffs will allow the player a longer period before their success chance decreases below 100%. Players should generally aim for a 100% success time of 5 minutes, which is the time that the Crystal Mask spell lasts. Refreshing the spell also refreshes the player's success chance. Players may choose to employ one of the following strategies depending on their available buffs:

  • Both Crystal Mask and Light Form: With both of these, players with the minimum Thieving level and no buffs have a 100% success rate for 4 minutes. Players should aim to reach 5 minutes (the refresh time of Crystal Mask) by adding the at least +9% success chance in other buffs or Thieving levels. Players will need both runes and prayer upkeep supplies.
  • Crystal Mask only: Players can reach 5 minutes of 100% success rate with +24% in other buffs or Thieving levels. Players using this method do not need to upkeep prayer points.
  • No Crystal Mask: Players with most or all available buffs and a high level will have a high enough success chance that they no longer need to use Crystal Mask. This allows for AFK times slightly longer than five minutes.

Damage will be taken if the player gets caught before refreshing their pickpocketing, but this can be outhealed by natural life point regeneration if using the above strategies.

The base maximum pickpocketing rate is 3000 per hour if using the Sticky Fingers relic and 2000 per hour otherwise. The master camouflage outfit provides a 7% chance to double the loot, resulting in loot equivalent to 3210 pickpockets per hour, not taking movement into account. For the other camouflage outfits, the chance is 5%. If not using Sticky Fingers, the mushroomy pickpocketing bag has a 5% chance to speed up pickpocketing by one tick, increasing the rate from 2000 to 2034 pickpockets per hour. The experience gain remains roughly the same with or without the Sticky Fingers relic as the experience per pickpocket is adjusted. About a +3% success chance boost is needed with the relic to reach the same AFK times as the change to the success chance decay per pickpocket does not account for the sped up initial bonus success pickpockets.

Archaeology professors at different sites vary in the types of materials that can be looted from them. In addition, all professors excluding the one at the Archaeology campus have a 1/1000 chance to give a damaged artefact from the respective dig site. This may or may not be desirable. Damaged artefacts can be restored and disassembled for invention materials, which is usually profitable, but obtaining artefacts will also clutter the player's inventory if pickpocketing for long sessions.

  • The chronotes, binding contracts, tetracompass pieces, and Archaeology boost items take up a total of 10 inventory slots.
  • The archaeology materials will take up 8 to 14 inventory slots, depending on the location.

This leaves anywhere from 4 to 10 inventory slots available. A grasping rune pouch is especially helpful for this if using Crystal Mask, and players using the Prosper perk should bring Charos' clue carrier. Players can also bank the Archaeology journal they likely used to travel before entering the dig site. If inventory space is still an issue, consider choosing a digsite with a smaller variety of Archaeology materials, or go for the Archaeology campus professor to avoid getting artefacts. Otherwise, players can pick the location with the best profit, which can vary significantly with the price fluctuations of materials.

The profit listed does not take into account the value of the ancient caskets from completing the obtained tetracompasses, which requires additional time investment. Players obtain the tetracompass in pieces and will have to first restore it with Archaeology materials. This gives a net value of 1,362,723 gp per tetracompass, after subtracting the cost of the materials used to restore it, including the value of the binding contracts and misc rewards, but excluding the value of the clues obtained and very rare chance at a shadowy key.

m.post:
Priffdinnas clan workers function slightly differently from standard pickpocketing targets. Instead of doing damage upon catching the player, they have a three strike system where getting caught three times will prevent the player from getting pickpocketing the same clan for 20 minutes (15 minutes with the Totem of Crystal). While the system was designed so that players rotate between three or more clans, the changes to pickpocketing mechanics allow players to pickpocket the same clan indefinitely as long as they refresh their pickpocketing =before being caught. A sound cue will play when the pickpocketing success chance drops below 100%; players should switch to another worker when this happens. Alternatively, players who maintain a 5 minute 100% success time with the Crystal Mask strategy will naturally refresh their buff when recasting the spell at the 5 minute mark.

Pickpocketing success chance decays over time (1% per 7.2 seconds after initial bonus success pickpockets), so stacking more buffs will allow the player a longer period before their success chance decreases below 100%. Players should generally aim for a 100% success time of 5 minutes, which is the time that the Crystal Mask spell lasts. Refreshing the spell also refreshes the player's success chance. Players may choose to employ one of the following strategies depending on their available buffs:

  • Both Crystal Mask and Light Form: With both of these, players with the minimum Thieving level and no buffs have a 100% success rate for 4 minutes. Players should aim to reach 5 minutes (the refresh time of Crystal Mask) by adding the at least +9% success chance in other buffs or Thieving levels. Prayer points can be easily restored at the Iowerth or Hefin clan altars if the player does not have an ancient elven ritual shard.
  • Crystal Mask only: Players can reach 5 minutes of 100% success rate with +24% in other buffs or Thieving levels. Players using this method do not need to upkeep prayer points.
  • No Crystal Mask: Players with most or all available buffs and a high level will have a high enough success chance that they no longer need to use Crystal Mask. This allows for AFK times slightly longer than five minutes.

Workers from all clans have at least one uncommon item on their loot table that is not stackable, so the Thieving cape is recommended for this activity. Players without the Thieving cape can use the banks in Prifddinas and should prioritize the clans which have them (Ithell, Trahaern, Hefin, Meilyr), unless they have an attuned crystal teleport seed, in which case they can quickly teleport to Ithell or Trahaern bank. Players may also choose to drop the unstackable items as they tend to be low value.

Players can choose which clan to pickpocket from based on their expected profit (variable, but prices are relatively stable) or other considerations. The table below lists some possible reasons:

In addition to this, the Voice of Seren boosts the Thieving experience in two districts per hour by 20%, so players may also choose to prioritise clans under its effect. The above experience rates are without the Voice of Seren's experience boost. It has no effect on the loot obtained.

The master camouflage outfit provides a 7% chance to double the loot, resulting in loot equivalent to 3210 pickpockets per hour, not taking movement into account. For the other camouflage outfits, the chance is 5%. If not using Sticky Fingers, the mushroomy pickpocketing bag has a 5% chance to speed up pickpocketing by one tick, increasing the rate from 2000 to 2034 pickpockets per hour. The experience gain remains roughly the same with or without the Sticky Fingers relic as the experience per pickpocket is adjusted. About a +3% success chance boost is needed with the relic to reach the same AFK times as the change to the success chance decay per pickpocket does not account for the sped up initial bonus success pickpockets.

With sufficiently high Thieving and Agility levels, the player will have a chance to pickpocket multiple loot at once:

  • Double loot with +10 Thieving levels over the minimum and an Agility level equal to the minimum Thieving level
  • Triple loot with +10 to both the previous levels (requires an Agility boost)

This additional loot is not factored into the above rates as the exact chance to multiply loot is not known. However, it is fairly common.

Paladins are a more accessible NPC for pickpocketing money making with two distinct advantages:

m.pg: Money making guide/Raising black dragons to adolescent
m.h: Black dragon eggs can be bought from the Grand Exchange and can reliably be sold to other players at the adolescent stage for a profit. This is done through direct trade to other players that are looking to sell these for beans.

Every 12 hours you can buy 6 frogs using beans from Prehistoric Potterington.

  1. Place these in the small pen
  2. When they are ready to harvest
  3. Sell them back to the collector yielding 450 beans.

Growing any other animals on your farm to sell for beans should cover the small difference in beans.

The frogs DO NOT need feeding to produce the poison slime, however if they are fed they will also yield a total of 24K-30K Farming Farming experience depending on their health and happiness. Purchasing flies from the pet shop in Taverley or Yanille is a cheap way to feed them if Farming XP is desired.

The Construction skill requirement may be assisted and is only required to build the pen.

m.t: Raising rex dinosaurs for bottled dinosaur roars

rq.h: A breeding pair of Bagrada rex, Corbicula rex, or Pavosaurus rex
Breeding pen and large pens constructed at the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm.
Studly or virile perks on the breeding pair recommended. Studly is better than virile.
Rabbit tier 2 Farm totem perk recommended.

inp.nt: Other types of meat are possible, see [[meaty mush]].

out.nt: From pavosaurus rex, see table below.
From pavosaurus rex, see table below. Value depends on use, see page.

m.h:
Bottled dinosaur roars are used in high level potions (for example vulnerability bombs). Raising rex dinosaurs with the goal of getting these roars can be profitable while also giving a lot of farming experience. With an optimal setup, seven animals can be growing at all time on average, using a single breeding pair in the breeding pen. Higher level dinosaurs give more experience and resources.

The strategy for this method is as follows:

  • Go to the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm. It can be reached from a Max Guild garden skilling portal (including through grace of the elves), or the mystical tree upstairs in the Manor Farm.
  • Check the large pens and breeding pen. Any animals should be health checked, and any non-breeding elder animals should be removed. Make sure the troughs have enough food to last until your next visit.
  • Check the breeding pen. If the large pens have space, move non-breeding animals to large pens.
  • If all pens are full, temporarily replace breeding animals with a male and a female adult animals (if possible). It is better to have animals with bad perks breeding than no animals breeding at all. This way, you can have up to 10 animals growing at the same time.
  • If space is available again, put the breeding pair back in the breeding pen.
  • Sell elder animals (except breeding pair) for beans or to other players.

It is recommended to check once or twice per day to maintain the 7 animal average. Higher level animals grow slower and make maintaining the average easier, but it is feasible to do this with any of the large pen dinosaurs.

Maintaining food in the large pens is not required, but healthy and happy animals give significantly more experience than sick ones. The produce remains the same. Meat can be purchased from the grand exchange or from Fresh Meat after As a First Resort.

Keep an eye out for animals with the traits 'Young at Heart' and 'Old at Heart', which will alter by 25% how slowly any animals possessing these traits will age. Young at Heart animals age 25% slower than normal. Old at Heart animals age 25% faster.

m.pg: Money making guide/Recharging rings of Wealth
m.h:
Charged Rings of Wealth are used to teleport to the Grand Exchange or Miscellania. The jewellery market on the Grand Exchange can be very volatile, so it is recommended to test out the profit before buying in bulk. Rings of Wealth have a buy limit of 500 per 4 hours, so it may be useful to put in an overnight offer for rings if you have enough money to start with.

  1. Teleport to the Burthorpe lodestone
  2. Withdraw 28 rings of Wealth from the bank chest
  3. Run to the Heroes' guild, enter the Heroes' Guild Mine
  4. Charge all of your rings
  5. Return to the lodestone and repeat.

Each lap should take about 75 seconds, so you can do about 100 rings in 5 minutes.

m.pg: Money making guide/Recharging rings of Wealth

inp.nt: [[crystal teleport seed]] recharge

m.h:
Charged Rings of Wealth are used to teleport to the Grand Exchange or Miscellania. The jewellery market on the Grand Exchange can be very volatile, so it is recommended to test out the profit before buying in bulk. Rings of Wealth have a buy limit of 500 per 4 hours, so it may be useful to put in an overnight offer for rings if you have enough money to start with.

  1. Starting at any bank
  2. Withdraw 27 uncharged rings of Wealth and your crystal teleport seed. If you have an attuned crystal teleport seed, you can put that in your pocket slot and bring 28 rings instead
  3. Use the crystal teleport seed to teleport to the Cadarn district
  4. Recharge the rings at The Tears of Seren
  5. Teleport to any bank - using the crystal seed to teleport to the Ithell district brings you very close to a bank chest.
  6. Repeat

Each lap should take about 25 seconds, so you can charge 100 rings in about 1 minute 40 seconds.

m.t: Recharging Rings of Wealth using a Geyser titan
m.pg: Money making guide/Recharging rings of Wealth

rq.h: Plague's End

m.h:
Charged Rings of Wealth are used to teleport to the Grand Exchange or Miscellania. The jewellery market on the Grand Exchange can be very volatile, so it is recommended to test out the profit before buying in bulk. Rings of Wealth have a buy limit of 500 per 4 hours, so it may be useful to put in an overnight offer for rings if you have enough money to start with.

Players with a Summoning level of at least 89 can summon a geyser titan, which can recharge uncharged rings of Wealth very quickly anywhere.

  1. Simply summon a geyser titan
  2. Fill your inventory with uncharged rings of Wealth, then use them on the titan
  3. This instantly recharges the rings, much like the fountain of heroes or the tears of Seren.
  4. Repeat

m.t: Running the Anachronia Agility Course for codex pages
m.pg: Money making guide/Running the Anachronia Agility Course for codex pages

rq.h: Bladed Dive or Dive

out.nt: Can only be converted from the [[codex page]]s received in increments of 750. This means it will generally take around 9 hours to obtain any money from this method.

m.h:
The profit assumes an average of 2 extra codex pages per lap and running 9 laps an hour using 2 doses of powerburst of acceleration per lap.

Each lap at the Anachronia Agility Course gives a guaranteed 10 codex pages. An additional 1-3 codex pages can be randomly received when completing any obstacle. By having at least tier three luck (such as a ring of fortune or a charged collector's insignia), players can improve their chances of gaining additional codex pages when completing obstacles. With tier 3 luck, each lap will grant a total of 12 codex pages on average.

The course is spread out with open areas between obstacles. Using Bladed Dive or Dive and Surge, along with the Mobile perk will allow for faster laps (up to an additional lap per hour). Powerbursts of acceleration can also be used to quickly surge and dive on parts of the course, further saving time. With double surge, dive, mobile, and an optimised route, players can expect lap times of around 6 minutes, allowing for 9 to 10 laps per hour. Double surge is highly recommended; without it, each lap will take 6:30 to 7 minutes or even longer, which hurts the profit rate significantly.

At level Agility, one bite of summer pie can be used per lap if used at the first level 85 obstacle (675 coins per lap). Once per day, a god banner can also be used to boost the player's Agility level by 5 for 30 minutes (roughly 4 laps). At level Agility, one dose of agility potion can be used per lap if used at the first level 85 obstacle (309 coins per lap).

When used to create a tradeable Double Surge codex, each page is worth 147,717.03 gp coins. When used to create a tradeable Double Escape codex, each page is worth 120,288.03 gp coins.
